_about: The phase-ins of ESRS for E1, E3 and E4, quoted, with the facts each depends on, read by services/governance/esrs_checks.py. A phase-in is the undertaking's option ('may omit'): it records which one it uses for an omitted item, and the check verifies the facts. year = the financial year's start year (2026/1563 ESRS 1 §121); year_index = year - the first financial year the undertaking was required to report + 1 (csrd.first_reporting_year); wave 'a' = required for a financial year starting 2024-2026, 'b' = from 2027 (2026/1563 ESRS 1 §122). employees_not_exceeding compares csrd.employees_average (on a consolidated basis for a group). items_unclear: items the quoted words do not settle — omitting them under the phase-in is flagged for the undertaking, never passed or refused.

dr_2023_2772.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772), ESRS E1 E1-6
dr_2023_2772.quote: Undertakings or groups not exceeding on their balance sheet dates the average number of 750 employees during the financial year (on a consolidated basis where applicable) may omit the datapoints on scope 3 emissions and total GHG emissions for the first year of preparation of their sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C (2023/2772), ESRS E1 E1-9
dr_2023_2772.quote: The undertaking may omit the information prescribed by ESRS E1-9 for the first year of preparation of its sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C (2023/2772), ESRS E1 E1-9
dr_2023_2772.quote: The undertaking may comply with ESRS E1-9 by reporting only qualitative disclosures for the first 3 years of preparation of its sustainability statement, if it is impracticable to prepare quantitative disclosures.

dr_2023_2772.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C (2023/2772), ESRS E3 E3-5
dr_2023_2772.quote: The undertaking may omit the information prescribed by ESRS E3-5 for the first year of preparation of its sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C (2023/2772), ESRS E3 E3-5
dr_2023_2772.quote: The undertaking may comply with ESRS E3-5 by reporting only qualitative disclosures, for the first 3 years of preparation of its sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C (2023/2772), ESRS E4 all disclosure requirements
dr_2023_2772.quote: Undertakings or groups not exceeding on their balance sheet dates the average number of 750 employees during the financial year (on a consolidated basis where applicable) may omit the information specified in the disclosure requirements of ESRS E4 for the first 2 years of preparation of their sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C (2023/2772), ESRS E4 E4-6
dr_2023_2772.quote: The undertaking may omit the information prescribed by ESRS E4-6 for the first year of preparation of its sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C (2023/2772), ESRS E4 E4-6
dr_2023_2772.quote: The undertaking may comply with ESRS E4-6 by reporting only qualitative disclosures, for the first 3 years of preparation of its sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772+.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C as replaced by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/1416, ESRS E1 E1-6
dr_2023_2772+.quote: By way of derogation from the first sentence, undertakings as referred to in Article 5(2), first subparagraph, point (a), and third subparagraph, point (a), of Directive (EU) 2022/2464 not exceeding on their balance sheet dates the average number of 750 employees during the financial year (on a consolidated basis, where applicable) may omit the datapoints on scope 3 emissions and total GHG emissions for the first 3 years of preparation of their sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772+.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C as replaced by 2025/1416, ESRS E1 E1-9
dr_2023_2772+.quote: By way of derogation from the first sentence, undertakings as referred to in Article 5(2), first subparagraph, point (a), and third subparagraph, point (a), of Directive (EU) 2022/2464 may omit the information prescribed by ESRS E1-9 for the first 3 years of preparation of their sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772+.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C as replaced by 2025/1416, ESRS E3 E3-5
dr_2023_2772+.quote: By way of derogation from the first sentence, undertakings as referred to in Article 5(2), first subparagraph, point (a), and third subparagraph, point (a) of Directive (EU) 2022/2464 may omit the information prescribed by ESRS E3-5 for the first 3 years of preparation of their sustainability statement.

dr_2023_2772+.ref: ESRS 1 Appendix C as replaced by 2025/1416, ESRS E4 all disclosure requirements
dr_2023_2772+.quote: By way of derogation from the first sentence, undertakings as referred to in Article 5(2), first subparagraph, point (a), and third subparagraph, point (a), of Directive (EU) 2022/2464 may omit the information specified in the disclosure requirements of ESRS E4 for the first 3 years of preparation of their sustainability statement.

dr_2026_1563.quote: ‘Wave-one’ undertakings, as defined in paragraph 122, that on their balance sheet dates exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 000 000 and an average number of 1 000 employees during the financial year, may omit in their sustainability statement : (a) all the DRs of ESRS E4 Biodiversity and Ecosystems , ESRS S2 Workers in the Value Chain , ESRS S3 Affected Communities , and ESRS S4 Consumers and End-users for their financial years prior to financial year 2027, subject to the provisions of ESRS 2 General Disclosures , paragraphs 7 to 10;

(b) all information about anticipated financial effects , required in paragraph 27 of ESRS 2 General Disclosures and in ESRS E1-11 for their financial years prior to financial year 2028, with the exception of ESRS E1-11 paragraph 39(a)(b) and 40(a)(b);

(c) quantitative information about anticipated financial effects, required in paragraph 27 of ESRS 2 General Disclosures and in ESRS E1-11 for their financial years prior to financial year 2030, with the exception of ESRS E1-11 paragraph 39(a)(b) and 40(a)(b);

‘Wave-one’ undertakings, as defined in paragraph 122, that on their balance sheet dates do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 000 000 or an average number of 1 000 employees during the financial year may omit in their sustainability statement : (a) all the DRs of all topical standards for their financial years prior to financial year 2027, subject to the provisions of ESRS 2 General Disclosures , paragraphs 7 to 10;

(b) all information about anticipated financial effects , required in paragraph 27 of ESRS 2 General Disclosures and in ESRS E1-11 for their financial years prior to financial year 2028, with the exception of ESRS E1-11 paragraph 39(a)(b) and 40(a)(b);

(c) quantitative information about anticipated financial effects, required in paragraph 27 of ESRS 2 General Disclosures and in ESRS E1-11 for their financial years prior to financial year 2030, with the exception of ESRS E1-11 paragraph 39(a)(b) and 40(a)(b);

‘Other undertakings’ as defined in paragraph 122 may omit in their sustainability statement : (a) all the DRs of ESRS E4 Biodiversity and Ecosystems , ESRS S2 Workers in the Value Chain , ESRS S3 Affected Communities , and ESRS S4 Consumers and End-users for their first two financial years of reporting;

(b) all information about anticipated financial effects , required in paragraph 27 of ESRS 2 General Disclosures and in ESRS E1-11 for their first two financial years of reporting, with the exception of ESRS E1-11 paragraph 39(a)(b) and 40(a)(b);

(c) quantitative information about anticipated financial effects, required in paragraph 27 of ESRS 2 General Disclosures and in ESRS E1-11 for their first four financial years of reporting, with the exception of ESRS E1-11 paragraph 39(a)(b) and 40(a)(b);
